items.text: The scanner identifies valid deliverable folders, requires canonical metadata, recognizes the semantic baseline and accepted deliverable representation, accepts MEMORY.md, rejects _MEMORY.md, treats optional files as non-required, preserves working-root containment, and surfaces warnings and unknown conditions.

verification.text: Run the metadata-scanner and project-deliverables route fixtures identified by the source kit, then review path-containment, warning-propagation, and API-compatibility evidence against the source requirements.
